description: This file contains unit tests for various functions related to context window management, session registry, and model configuration resolution within a larger AI or language model project. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to verify behavior of functions like applyDiscoveredContextWindows, applyConfiguredContextWindows, createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry, and resolveContextTokensForModel.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredContextWindows
methods.description: Applies context window settings discovered from external sources to the cache, considering model ids and provider-qualified ids.

methods.name: applyConfiguredContextWindows
methods.description: Applies configuration-based context window settings to the cache, handling provider-specific models and ignoring invalid entries.

methods.name: createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry object that maps objects (by identity) to stored values, with methods to set, get, and clear entries.

methods.name: resolveContextTokensForModel
methods.description: Resolves the number of context tokens for a model considering configuration, provider settings, and special flags like 'context1m'.
